recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast urban design featuring a heavy-duty green camouflage canvas background with a prominent orange stenciled title that incorporates halftone textures and distressed edges.
coreVisualRelationships: Vibrant orange typography against muted olive and forest green camouflage
Coarse textile weave texture underlying all graphic elements
Stitched border framing the central typographic composition
Halftone dot patterns integrated into the letterforms to suggest screen-printing

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale title centered horizontally and vertically, dominating the middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold orange 'REHAB' text acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the large orange title, moves down to the smaller subtitle, then notices the stitched border and fabric texture.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The camouflage pattern fills all negative space, providing a busy but low-contrast environment.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-saturation, high-value orange text pops against low-saturation, medium-value background.

letterConstructionRules: Rough, eroded edges simulating spray-paint or worn ink
Slightly irregular baseline for a hand-applied look
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters feature 'splatter' artifacts around the perimeters
Sub-text is enclosed by small horizontal dashes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A smaller, cleaner version of the same distressed sans-serif for secondary information.
graphicDevices: Fabric seam on the left edge

candidateDirections.reason: Strong, blocky skeleton suitable for distressing

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a top-down view of a heavy olive green canvas fabric with a woodland camouflage print. Include a visible seam on the left and a rectangular orange-thread stitched border in the center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply bold, uppercase orange text in a distressed sans-serif font. Add a halftone dot texture inside the letters and erode the edges to look like a worn screen print.

verificationChecks: Is the canvas texture visible through the text?
Is the orange sufficiently vibrant against the green?
Are the edges of the letters appropriately 'rough'?

adjustableVariables: Level of edge erosion on text
mustRedesign: Exact letter spacing of the original
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the texture of the canvas is consistent across the frame.
Check that the orange text does not have a drop shadow.
Verify the 'stitched' border looks like actual embroidery.
Confirm the camouflage colors are muted and earthy.
recipe.reuseFormula: Canvas Texture + Woodland Camo + Stitched Border + Distressed Orange Halftone Typography
